sources.title: Freeports technical handbook
sources.role: Official HMRC handbook for the Freeport customs procedure and customs-site operation.
sources.facts: Published 1 June 2026. It expressly covers customs procedures and sites, not Freeport tax sites or direct-tax incentives.
sources.guard: Freeport, Investment Zone, Enterprise Zone and special-tax-site guidance does not by itself prove that an exact property lies within a designated qualifying site, that a business or employee is eligible, that relief has been granted, or that regeneration, occupation, employment or investment will occur.

sources.title: Freeports technical handbook – Introduction
sources.role: Official definition and location overview for UK Freeports and customs sites.
sources.facts: Published 1 June 2026. A Freeport boundary is broader than its separately designated customs sites, so boundary inclusion alone does not establish customs eligibility.
sources.guard: Freeport, Investment Zone, Enterprise Zone and special-tax-site guidance does not by itself prove that an exact property lies within a designated qualifying site, that a business or employee is eligible, that relief has been granted, or that regeneration, occupation, employment or investment will occur.

sources.title: Business rates relief – Freeports relief
sources.role: Official eligibility and administration guidance for Freeport business-rates relief.
sources.facts: Relief depends on qualifying premises, timing, expansion or relocation circumstances and local-council administration; location alone does not prove entitlement.
sources.guard: Freeport, Investment Zone, Enterprise Zone and special-tax-site guidance does not by itself prove that an exact property lies within a designated qualifying site, that a business or employee is eligible, that relief has been granted, or that regeneration, occupation, employment or investment will occur.

sources.facts: Eligibility and amount depend on local rules, zone start date and business circumstances; the page is not an award record.

sources.facts: Updated 15 April 2026. Zone status is strategic and does not itself prove an exact-site tax designation, occupancy, delivery or investment outcome.
